data.name: InvalidTask
data.value: Invalid task or checklist. Completed items require evidence.

data.name: CompletedWithNext
data.value: A completed task cannot have another run scheduled.

data.name: StaleTask
data.value: The task changed. Reload it before saving.

data.name: FutureCheck
data.value: Schedule the next run in the future.

data.name: ResolveExecution
data.value: Resolve the active or uncertain execution before editing this task.

data.name: MissingNext
data.value: An unfinished task requires a next run time.

data.name: StaleRoutine
data.value: The recurrence changed. Reload it before saving.

data.name: InvalidRecurrence
data.value: The recurrence has no future occurrence.

data.name: InvalidOccurrence
data.value: The time does not belong to this recurrence.

data.name: RetiredPlan
data.value: Task updated; continue from its new checklist and scheduled time.

data.name: MissingProgress
data.value: Approved effects completed, but the internal checklist has no next check. Review task progress before continuing.

data.name: MissingPlanningProgress
data.value: The internal checklist needs a verified progress update or a next check. Plan that task update rather than abandoning the task.

data.name: LegacyWaiting
data.value: Legacy waiting state removed. Review the remaining work before continuing.

data.name: ExternalSourceOwned
data.value: Edit the title and instructions in the external source. Inactive source tasks cannot be scheduled.

data.name: SourceUnavailable
data.value: The external task could not be verified. Refresh its source before approving execution again.

data.name: InterruptedExecution
data.value: Samwise restarted during execution. The external result is unknown and the upstream agent may still be running. Reconcile its invocation and external effects before closing this work item; no automatic retry was scheduled.

data.name: ChangedSource
data.value: Review the changed Todoist instructions and verify whether additional work is required. Preserve completed effects.
